references.title: Trajectory bundle (results.json + simulations/ + audio) — 50 tasks, hosted

methodology.notes: CUSTOM CASCADED VOICE AGENT (not a native audio-realtime model). Pipeline: Soniox STT (stt-rt-v5) -> Humains bCortex multi-state orchestrator (gemini-3.5-flash on Vertex AI, thinkingLevel=low; a same-model AI-Studio fallback engaged on ~1% of inferences under transient Vertex 429 rate-limiting, and that fallback path does not apply the thinking cap) -> OpenAI TTS (gpt-4o-mini-tts, voice 'alloy'). A turn-taking politeness adapter sits between the bench and bCortex (dead-air filler utterances, answerless-CoT liveness watchdog, STT-reconnect ear watchdog, stale-drop/soft-yield/yield-truncate, 2-second collision-protection rule, uninterruptible reassurance, backchannel gate, fuzzy dedupe; barge-in master switch disabled). Agent prompts are custom multi-state prompts with airline-specific doctrine (near-match ID/reservation recovery anchored to a phone-line lookup exception; answer-from-the-named-reservation-only). Single trial, Pass^1 only (audio-native multi-trial is expensive; higher Pass^k are null). All 50 airline tasks evaluated at 'regular' speech complexity; no tasks omitted. TTS substitution: Soniox persona-equivalent voices were used in place of the held-out ElevenLabs voices (credits exhausted) — Sierra to re-run with held-out voices per the voice policy. 9 tasks (34,36,38,41,43,45,46,48,49) first hit a transient OpenAI user-simulator connection error and were cleanly re-run; the infra-errored sims are excluded, only clean re-runs are in the board.

verification.details: Custom cascaded scaffold + custom multi-state prompts + custom turn-taking adapter. All 50 airline tasks scored, regular speech complexity, 1 trial. See notes for the TTS-substitution caveat.
